testable_hypothesis.statement: Insufficient explicit same-color train-only protection may contribute to the observed R1/R2 same-color forgetting.
testable_hypothesis.evidence_needed: A distinct prospective protocol holding all other selected factors fixed while adding same-color train-only replay.

future_review_requirement: At each major targeted-training protocol review, report explicit train-only preservation coverage for every strong baseline capability; lack of coverage is a scientific risk to record, not a provenance gate.
